diagram_candidates.claim: The solution value at (x,t) depends only on the initial interval [x-ct,x+ct].
diagram_candidates.proposal: In an (x,t) plane mark the vertex (x,t), draw the backward characteristic segments x(s)=x±c(t-s) to t=0, and shade their base interval [x-ct,x+ct]; label the two characteristic slopes ±c and the d’Alembert endpoint/integral dependence. The two characteristic boundaries must meet at (x,t) and terminate at the stated interval endpoints.

diagram_candidates.claim: For y u_xx+u_yy=0 the type changes across y=0: elliptic for y>0, hyperbolic for y<0, and parabolic on y=0.
diagram_candidates.proposal: Draw the (x,y) plane with the degeneracy line y=0 separating the upper elliptic and lower hyperbolic regions; place a point on y=0 and annotate the principal coefficient matrix diag(y,1), determinant y and discriminant -y, showing rank one on the line. Do not draw a solution profile or imply a global type away from each point.

diagram_candidates.claim: A right-moving packet u(x,t)=F(x-ct) leaves the fixed interval (0,1), and its energy changes by q(0,t)-q(1,t).
diagram_candidates.proposal: Use an x-t strip with vertical walls x=0 and x=1, draw packet support translated along x=ct+supp F, and show its crossing of the right wall. Mark EΩ(0)>0 and EΩ(t)=0 after exit, with outward flux terms q(0,t)-q(1,t); place the support wholly within the strip initially and wholly to the right after exit.

diagram_candidates.claim: The slit disc Ω is smooth and harmonic in its interior but has a reentrant boundary point at 0 where the Hessian integral diverges.
diagram_candidates.proposal: Draw the unit disc with the nonpositive real radius removed, label both slit banks as boundary, place the tip at 0, and mark polar coordinates with opening angle 2π and u(r,θ)=r^{1/2}sin(θ/2). Show the square-root map sending the slit plane to the right half-plane. Preserve that no boundary C¹ chart exists at the tip.
